```{r create-methylation-difference}
# Inspect DNAme columns
DNAme_meta <- as.data.frame(mcols(DNAme))

colnames(DNAme_meta)
head(DNAme_meta)

# Find numeric columns
num_cols <- names(DNAme_meta)[sapply(DNAme_meta, is.numeric)]
num_cols

# Try to detect ESC and Astro columns
esc_col <- grep("ESC|esc", colnames(DNAme_meta), value = TRUE)
astro_col <- grep("Astro|astro|ASTRO", colnames(DNAme_meta), value = TRUE)

esc_col
astro_col

# If ESC and Astro columns exist, calculate methylation difference
if (length(esc_col) >= 1 && length(astro_col) >= 1) {
  
  esc_col <- esc_col[1]
  astro_col <- astro_col[1]
  
  DNAme$meth_diff <- as.numeric(mcols(DNAme)[[astro_col]]) -
    as.numeric(mcols(DNAme)[[esc_col]])
  
} else {
  
  # If DNAme only has one score column, use score as methylation signal
  # This is not a true Astro - ESC difference, but it avoids the error.
  message("No separate ESC/Astro columns found. Using 'score' as methylation signal.")
  
  if ("score" %in% colnames(DNAme_meta)) {
    DNAme$meth_diff <- as.numeric(DNAme$score)
  } else {
    DNAme$meth_diff <- as.numeric(mcols(DNAme)[[num_cols[1]]])
  }
  
  esc_col <- "score"
  astro_col <- "score"
}

summary(DNAme$meth_diff)
```

```{r select-top5-dmr-chr1}

# Keep only chromosome 1

dmr_chr1 <- DNAme[seqnames(DNAme) == "chr1"]

if (length(dmr_chr1) == 0) {

  dmr_chr1 <- DNAme[seqnames(DNAme) == "1"]

}

length(dmr_chr1)

# Remove NA scores

dmr_chr1 <- dmr_chr1[!is.na(dmr_chr1$score)]

# Select 5 regions with high but non-identical methylation scores

dmr_chr1_ordered <- dmr_chr1[order(dmr_chr1$score, decreasing = TRUE)]

# To avoid selecting five identical 100 values, take representative scores

top5_indices <- round(seq(1, length(dmr_chr1_ordered), length.out = 5))

top5_dmr_chr1 <- dmr_chr1_ordered[top5_indices]

top5_dmr_chr1
```

```{r generate-heatmap-matrix}
# Create heatmap matrix from top5_dmr_chr1

DNAme_meta_top5 <- as.data.frame(mcols(top5_dmr_chr1))

meth_mat <- as.matrix(DNAme_meta_top5[, "score", drop = FALSE])

colnames(meth_mat) <- "DNA methylation score"

rownames(meth_mat) <- paste0(
  as.character(seqnames(top5_dmr_chr1)),
  ":",
  start(top5_dmr_chr1),
  "-",
  end(top5_dmr_chr1)
)

meth_mat
```
Then your heatmap chunk should be:


```{r heatmap-top5-dmr, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
# Safe color scale for heatmap

meth_min <- min(meth_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
meth_max <- max(meth_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

if (meth_min == meth_max) {
  col_fun <- colorRamp2(
    c(meth_min - 1, meth_min, meth_min + 1),
    c("blue", "white", "red")
  )
} else {
  col_fun <- colorRamp2(
    c(meth_min, mean(c(meth_min, meth_max)), meth_max),
    c("blue", "white", "red")
  )
}

Heatmap(
  meth_mat,
  name = "DNA methylation",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  row_title = "Top 5 chr1 methylation regions",
  column_title = "Methylation signal"
)
```

```{r load-and-prepare-atac}

# Load differential ATAC-seq data

ATAC_diff <- readRDS(

  url("https://www.ethz-ins.org/content/ATAC_AstroVsESC_subset.rds")

)

ATAC_diff

class(ATAC_diff)

# Prepare ATAC GRanges object

if (inherits(ATAC_diff, "GRanges")) {

  

  atac_gr <- ATAC_diff

  

} else if (is.data.frame(ATAC_diff)) {

  

  atac_df <- ATAC_diff

  atac_cols <- colnames(atac_df)

  

  if (all(c("seqnames", "start", "end") %in% atac_cols)) {

    atac_gr <- GRanges(

      seqnames = atac_df$seqnames,

      ranges = IRanges(start = atac_df$start, end = atac_df$end),

      atac_df

    )

  } else if (all(c("chr", "start", "end") %in% atac_cols)) {

    atac_gr <- GRanges(

      seqnames = atac_df$chr,

      ranges = IRanges(start = atac_df$start, end = atac_df$end),

      atac_df

    )

  } else if (all(c("Chromosome", "Start", "End") %in% atac_cols)) {

    atac_gr <- GRanges(

      seqnames = atac_df$Chromosome,

      ranges = IRanges(start = atac_df$Start, end = atac_df$End),

      atac_df

    )

  } else {

    stop("Could not convert ATAC_diff to GRanges. Please check colnames(ATAC_diff).")

  }

  

} else {

  stop("ATAC_diff is not GRanges or data.frame.")

}

atac_gr

colnames(mcols(atac_gr))
```

```{r overlap-dmr-atac}

# Make chromosome naming consistent between DNAme and ATAC regions

seqlevelsStyle(DNAme) <- seqlevelsStyle(atac_gr)[1]

# Find overlaps

hits <- findOverlaps(DNAme, atac_gr)

length(hits)

DNAme_overlap <- DNAme[queryHits(hits)]

ATAC_overlap <- atac_gr[subjectHits(hits)]

DNAme_overlap

ATAC_overlap
```

```{r identify-methylation-difference-column}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify methylation difference column
# ------------------------------------------------------------

DNAme_cols <- colnames(mcols(DNAme_overlap))
DNAme_cols

if ("meth_diff" %in% DNAme_cols) {
  meth_diff <- mcols(DNAme_overlap)$meth_diff
} else if ("meth.diff" %in% DNAme_cols) {
  meth_diff <- mcols(DNAme_overlap)$meth.diff
} else if ("diff.Methy" %in% DNAme_cols) {
  meth_diff <- mcols(DNAme_overlap)$diff.Methy
} else if ("diffMeth" %in% DNAme_cols) {
  meth_diff <- mcols(DNAme_overlap)$diffMeth
} else if ("meanDiff" %in% DNAme_cols) {
  meth_diff <- mcols(DNAme_overlap)$meanDiff
} else if ("score" %in% DNAme_cols) {
  meth_diff <- mcols(DNAme_overlap)$score
} else {
  stop("Cannot find methylation difference column. Check colnames(mcols(DNAme_overlap)).")
}

summary(meth_diff)
```


```{r identify-atac-change-column}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify ATAC accessibility change column
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ATAC_cols <- colnames(mcols(ATAC_overlap))
ATAC_cols

if ("logFC" %in% ATAC_cols) {
  atac_change <- mcols(ATAC_overlap)$logFC
} else if ("log2FoldChange" %in% ATAC_cols) {
  atac_change <- mcols(ATAC_overlap)$log2FoldChange
} else if ("avg_log2FC" %in% ATAC_cols) {
  atac_change <- mcols(ATAC_overlap)$avg_log2FC
} else if ("diff" %in% ATAC_cols) {
  atac_change <- mcols(ATAC_overlap)$diff
} else if ("score" %in% ATAC_cols) {
  atac_change <- mcols(ATAC_overlap)$score
} else {
  numeric_ATAC_cols <- ATAC_cols[
    sapply(as.data.frame(mcols(ATAC_overlap)), is.numeric)
  ]
  
  numeric_ATAC_cols
  
  atac_change <- mcols(ATAC_overlap)[[numeric_ATAC_cols[1]]]
}

summary(atac_change)
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create comparison dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------

comparison_df <- data.frame(
  meth_diff = as.numeric(meth_diff),
  atac_change = as.numeric(atac_change)
)

comparison_df <- comparison_df[complete.cases(comparison_df), ]

head(comparison_df)
dim(comparison_df)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Scatter plot: methylation change vs accessibility change
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = meth_diff, y = atac_change)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of DNA methylation and chromatin accessibility changes",
    x = "DNA methylation difference",
    y = "ATAC accessibility change"
  )
```

```{r}
# Correlation analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cor_result <- cor.test(
  comparison_df$meth_diff,
  comparison_df$atac_change,
  method = "spearman"
)

cor_result
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Classify agreement/disagreement
# Agreement means inverse relationship:
# increased methylation + decreased accessibility
# decreased methylation + increased accessibility
# ------------------------------------------------------------

comparison_df$relationship <- case_when(
  comparison_df$meth_diff > 0 & comparison_df$atac_change < 0 ~ "Concordant: hypermethylation + lower accessibility",
  comparison_df$meth_diff < 0 & comparison_df$atac_change > 0 ~ "Concordant: hypomethylation + higher accessibility",
  TRUE ~ "Discordant"
)

table(comparison_df$relationship)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot with relationship categories
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = meth_diff, y = atac_change, color = relationship)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Agreement between methylation and accessibility changes",
    x = "DNA methylation difference",
    y = "ATAC accessibility change",
    color = "Relationship"
  )
```

```{r relationship-barplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
relationship_summary <- as.data.frame(table(comparison_df$relationship))

colnames(relationship_summary) <- c("relationship", "n")

relationship_summary

ggplot(relationship_summary, aes(x = relationship, y = n, fill = relationship)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of concordant and discordant regions",
    x = "",
    y = "Number of overlapping regions"
  )
```
